source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
Csquare SFO4 publishes 129.4 MW of combined utility power across 273,000 square feet of technical space. The spec page does not separate IT load from total utility draw, so the usable compute power is not published. If the facility runs at a typical power usage effectiveness of 1.4, IT load would be roughly 92 MW. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 92 MW of IT load is roughly 2,300 racks. That arithmetic is an assumption chain, not an operator claim.

The six certifications qualify the campus to host workloads subject to financial audit controls (SOC 1 Type 2), security and availability audits (SOC 2 Type 2), payment card data (PCI DSS), international information security management requirements (ISO 27001), federal risk and authorization controls (NIST 800-53), and sustainable building standards (LEED). Which tenants use those qualifications is not published.

California has 103 facilities mapped in this site's data, of which only seven publish a megawatt figure. Those seven sum to 185 MW. SFO4 is ranked eighth by published megawatts in the state, meaning its 129.4 MW exceeds the published figure of every facility this site has read a number for in California. That ranking reflects the narrowness of the published sample, not a complete picture of California capacity.
